content.text: /ext:medcp How many patients have had an ALT measured at least once?

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT concept_id, concept_name, vocabulary_id, concept_code, standard_concept, domain_id, concept_class_id
FROM omop.concept
WHERE domain_id = 'Measurement'
  AND (
    LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%alanine aminotransferase%'
    OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%alt%'
  )
ORDER BY CASE WHEN LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%alanine aminotransferase%' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, concept_name
LIMIT 50

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT c.concept_id, c.concept_name, c.concept_code, COUNT(*) AS measurement_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m.person_id) AS patient_count
FROM omop.measurement m
JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id = m.measurement_concept_id
WHERE c.domain_id = 'Measurement'
  AND c.vocabulary_id = 'LOINC'
  AND c.standard_concept = 'S'
  AND LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE 'alanine aminotransferase%'
  AND LOWER(c.concept_name) NOT LIKE '%aspartate%'
  AND LOWER(c.concept_name) NOT LIKE '%ratio%'
  AND LOWER(c.concept_name) NOT LIKE '%macromolecular%'
GROUP BY c.concept_id, c.concept_name, c.concept_code
ORDER BY patient_count DESC
